title: Energetic Extermination
wikitext:
'''Energetic Extermination''' was an international amateur multigaming clan from [[Germany]].

Founded in 2000 by the gamers ''cekay'' and ''NeWsAgE'', the clan has been active in several games like ''Tactical Ops'', ''Unreal Tournament'', ''Halo'', ''Red Faction'', ''Diablo II'', ''Soldat'' and ''Black & White''. Especially in the games ''Tactical Ops'' and ''Unreal Tournament'', the clan participated in official matches of the ''EWL'' and the ''Gamestar League''.

In 2006 the clan get inactive for years. After the temporary dissolution of the clan in 2008, some members were active in the game ''Quake Live'' for a while.
